text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — target cutoff is Fri 10:00 PT. We need all vendor/submodule lockfile bumps merged into release/candidate before that. If your PR touches vendor/ or third_party/ and isn't merged by cutoff it'll be scheduled for the post-cut release train. Please label PRs with `release/dep` and include a short `CHANGELOG.md` blurb. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ravi Patel: Any known semver breaks from the recent grpc bump? I hit one integration failure locally.

Alex Gomez: CI showed a flaky builder image mismatch earlier — re-ran the matrix with:
```bash
bazel test //... --config=linux_x64 --test_output=errors
```
that passed for me. If the failure is only in one matrix cell we can pin the image in a follow-up.

Priya Singh: I'll take the `third_party/fastmath` lockfile bump and open a PR by EOD. Will add `release/dep` label and a concise changelog line. Who can review vendor CI?

Maya Chen: Thanks Priya. @Linus Park can you do the vendor CI review once the PR is up? Also please add `ci-skip: false` to the PR body so release-bot doesn't treat it as cosmetic.

release-bot: Reminder — release cutoff for branch `release/candidate` in 48 hours. Auto-merge and branch-cut operations will be disabled 1 hour before cutoff. See <https://internal.redwood/release/cutoff> for the checklist.

Linus Park: Happy to review vendor CI. Alex, can you paste the failing job logs here? I need the build matrix cell output.

Alex Gomez: Pasting the snippet I captured from the failing job:
```
FAIL: //runtime:kv_store_test (see //bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/testlogs/runtime/kv_store_test/test.log)
AssertionError: expected 0 errors but got 1
Stack: third_party/fastmath/src/fast_op.cc:42
```
Looks like a strict overflow check triggered after the fastmath bump.

Ravi Patel: If that's a behavioral change in fastmath we should either pin to the previous patch (v2.3.1) or coordinate with their patch release. Given the cutoff timeline, a revert/pin PR may be fastest. I can prepare a revert PR to 2.3.1 today.

Maya Chen: Ok plan: Priya sends the fastmath lockfile PR; Alex sends the builder-image pin PR for the flaky matrix cell; Ravi prepares a revert/pin to grpc/fastmath if tests fail. We'll try to get all green merges into `release/candidate` before cutoff. If anything blocks, escalate to oncall.

Casey (release-coordinator): Noted. I'll keep a short 15-min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to triage anything still open. If you need approvals faster, drop a :bell: in the PR and DM me.

Priya Singh: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/8421 — includes lockfile bump, changelog line, and `release/dep` label. CI started.

Linus Park: Reviewing now. Two quick comments on the vendor CI config (missing `--no-cache` flag for build step) — will leave inline.

Alex Gomez: Opened builder-image pin PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/8422 — pins builder image to `redwood/builder:2026-03-10`.

Ravi Patel: Revert PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/8423 — pins fastmath to v2.3.1 and updates lockfile. Running full integration locally now.

Maya Chen: Great. If all three PRs are green by slice time we'll merge to `release/candidate`. If the integration still fails after Ravi's revert, we will escalate. Thanks everyone — keep the pings short here and drop any urgent status in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
